notes.title: Apologies for the ranking
notes.notes:
There are currently no players displayed that exceed the developer's expectation of "This is the limit for human play within the time limit.". (We didn't BAN any players.)
Please accept our apologies for the complete underestimation of the player's game skill.
This game is currently experiencing errors on Unity and is difficult to fix. 
(This is the only Sonic-Alpha game that hasn't been updated.)
If we can fix it, we can increase the upper limit.
If it cannot be fixed, we would like to reduce the price gradually.
We don't think the ranking will be implemented in Sonic-Alpha games in the future.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
